title: CEO Command Center
description: Executive KPI cards (Pending SO, Total SO, Stock, AR/AP, PDC Payable, Cash in Hand/Bank/Net Cash, Headcount, Payroll, HR) with detail dashboards, plus P/L, cash flow, inventory, pipeline.
notes: Card formulas: Pending SO = submitted SO in To Deliver and Bill/To Bill/To Deliver/To Pay, sum(base_grand_total - advance_paid). Total SO = count in period. Stock = Bin.stock_value. AR/AP = Payment Ledger outstanding. PDC Pending Payable = PE custom_pdc_payment + Pending + Pay (requires pdc_cheques). Cash in Hand/Bank/Net Cash on the Desk KPI page use get_balance_on (excludes Company PDC accounts); workbook GL sum approximates live balances when date filter is not applied. Headcount = Active Employee. Salary = submitted Salary Slip base_gross_pay (Payroll Cost Gross). HR KPI = headcount mosaic with hires/exits (no weighted score). Desk page: ceo-insight-dashboard. After deploy, Insights → Templates → update CEO Command Center. Number charts are one-measure-per-card for Insights v3 layout.
